title: Inception
overview: A thief uses dream technology to enter human minds and steal secrets. His final mission: plant an idea deep inside a target's mind and shape the future.

title: The Matrix
overview: A hacker discovers that reality is a machine simulation and joins the rebels in a war against the machines for the future of humanity.

title: Interstellar
overview: With Earth dying, explorers pilot a spacecraft through a wormhole, searching distant worlds for a new future for humanity.

title: Blade Runner 2049
overview: In a future ruled by technology and artificial humans, a young cop uncovers a buried secret that could break the balance between man and machine.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman must fight the Joker, a criminal mastermind whose only mission is to burn Gotham and prove that anyone can break.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: In the wasteland of a post-apocalyptic future, a drifter and a rebel driver fight a tyrant and his army in a brutal road war.

title: John Wick
overview: A retired hitman returns to the criminal underworld to fight an army of killers and take revenge for the last gift from his wife.

title: Die Hard
overview: An off-duty cop must fight terrorists who have taken hostages in a skyscraper - one man against a small army.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: A banker sentenced to life in prison never loses hope: he forms a deep friendship and quietly plans his freedom over long years.

title: Forrest Gump
overview: A kind-hearted man drifts through decades of American history, loving his childhood friend while fate carries him from war to fortune.

title: Fight Club
overview: An insomniac office worker and a charismatic soap maker build an underground club where men fight to feel alive - until it spirals out of control.

title: Whiplash
overview: A young jazz drummer endures the brutal methods of an abusive instructor who believes that greatness demands blood and obsession.

title: Titanic
overview: A poor artist and a young aristocratic woman fall in love aboard a doomed ship, defying class and family as the iceberg waits.

title: La La Land
overview: An actress and a jazz musician fall in love in Los Angeles, but their dreams pull the relationship in opposite directions.

title: The Notebook
overview: Two young lovers are separated by war, class and family - and fight to find their way back to each other years later.

title: Her
overview: A lonely writer falls in love with an intelligent operating system, and their relationship makes him question what love really means.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A young girl trapped in a magical bathhouse of spirits must find courage and friends to free her parents and return home.

title: Toy Story
overview: A cowboy toy feels replaced by a new space ranger, but their rivalry turns into friendship during a great adventure.

title: Up
overview: A widower ties thousands of balloons to his house and flies away. A young scout joins the adventure and teaches him what family means.

title: The Lion King
overview: A young lion flees after his father's death. Guided by new friends, he returns years later to reclaim his kingdom.

title: The Shining
overview: A writer spending the winter in an empty hotel descends into madness as the evil inside the building preys on his family.

title: Get Out
overview: A young man visits his girlfriend's family estate and slowly uncovers the terrifying secret hidden behind their warm welcome.

title: A Quiet Place
overview: A family survives in total silence, because creatures that hunt by sound have turned every noise into death. Survival means never being heard.

title: Parasite
overview: A poor family cons its way into a wealthy household, but a secret in the basement turns their clever scheme into a fight for survival.
